title: The normalized ordinary direct-image adjacent coefficient identity
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, any scheme map p:X→Y, and any section- and K-injective-normalized DirectData d [lem-sf-compact-support-proper-image-tower]. For any K in the unbounded derived category of completed coefficient modules and n≥0, sfDirectImageTransition p K n equals Res_(n+1) applied to D_(n+1)(reductionMap K n) followed by d.comparison_n, and then the completed restriction-composition map. Here D_n is the finite right-derived direct image and reductionMap is the scalar-adjunction transpose of the lower reduction unit [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. The two ordinary finite direct-image functors are definitionally equal, as recorded by sfFiniteDirectImage_presentation. There is no open immersion, compactification, completeness, finite-field or constructibility hypothesis and no tower-isomorphism conclusion.

proof.text: Identify the completed restriction of the actual normalized reductionMap with sfDerivedReductionTransition. Apply the normalized direct-image restriction pasting identity at the level-n scalar extension of K. Naturality of the level-(n+1) restriction comparison at reductionMap and functoriality of completed direct image then identify the two displayed composites after precomposition by the invertible comparison map. Cancel that map.

lean.statement:
theorem sfDirectImageTransition_presentation
    (d : CompactSupportProperImageTower.DirectData l E p)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    sfDirectImageTransition l E p K n =
      (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E Y (n + 1)).map
        ((compactSupportLevelDirectImage l E p (n + 1)).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          (CompactSupportProperImageTower.reductionMap l E X K n) ≫
          (d.comparison n).hom.app ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)) ≫
        (compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).hom.app
          ((compactSupportLevelDirectImage l E p n).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K))
